## Snapshot and verdicts

- **Frozen EN:** `6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f`
- **RU candidate:** `e5028c6d9d1c43655728f48ce9f748b495f4fdf9`
- **C1 Japanese accuracy/source fidelity: CLEAN**
- **C2 consistency/negative answers/dependencies: NEEDS_FIX**, with one additional pair question **UNVERIFIED**
- **C3 Russian comprehension: NEEDS_FIX**

These are bounded source-content verdicts, not whole-corpus, native/device, default-activation or release acceptance.

## Actual reading scope

I read the **complete frozen EN and candidate RU bodies** of all 14 primary articles:

開く、開ける、閉まる、閉める、消える、消す、始まる、止まる、並ぶ、並べる、付ける、締める、押す、引く.

I also read all 20 complete supporting EN/RU pairs:

着る、掛ける、履く、入れる、洗う、洗濯、終わる、立つ、待つ、休む、座る、遊ぶ、持つ、晴れる、同じ、起きる、砂糖、書く、咲く、広い.

Additional actual reading:

- All **679 compact pool rows**, indices **0–678**, in successive 50-row ranges and final range 650–678—not 679 article bodies.
- All **55 complete selected lexical objects**, indices **0–54**, including restrictions, alternate readings, information, tags and parts of speech. Oversized calls emitted no evidence; narrower successful retries supplied the complete objects.
- All four selected captured ranges: Weblio/Daijisen 留まる **25–76**; Kotobank/Daijisen 並ぶ **24–36**; Russian стирать **155–198**; Kotobank/Daijisen 付ける **24–68**. These were selected ranges, not entire pages.
- Active instructions, scoped content instructions, all three reviewer rubrics, relevant methodology/reference/worked adaptations, frozen confusable policy **1–65**, and relevant CW020/CW024/CW025/CW026/CW089 rows.
- All four bounded documentation diffs and all 27 source-link dispositions, compared with the full article bodies.
- Pinned app mapping **165–202**, solely for the separate `attachment` follow-up.

Hashes and projections were not treated as semantic reading.

## Findings

### 1. Learner-facing Russian wording obscures the dictionary-sense count

**`words\止まる.md:59–60`**

> в указанной трёхзначной статье JMdict.

The source says **“three-sense JMdict family.”** «Трёхзначная статья» is unnatural and readily suggests a three-digit entry, rather than an entry containing three meanings.

**Correction:**  
«в указанной статье JMdict с тремя значениями».

The broader perching, fixation and catching-the-eye teaching is otherwise preserved. This is a Russian wording defect, not an established Japanese example error.

### 2. Two proposal records misquote the actual accepted caption

- **`docs\translation-batches\036-state-changes-operations-candidate.json:457`**
- **`docs\translation-batches\036-state-changes-operations-source-adjudication.json:9461`**

The 止まる–終わる rationale claims the actual caption is:

> заканчиваться; завершаться

But **`words\終わる.md:4`** and actual pool row **548** contain:

> заканчиваться; заканчивать

**Correction:** quote the actual caption in both rationales. Do **not** change the unchanged baseline article to match the mistaken quotation.

This small evidence-record correction does not itself overturn the pair: its actual «заканчиваться» component remains relevant.

## Decisions on all 24 proposals

“Accept” means retaining a direct quiz safeguard—not declaring the Japanese constructions interchangeable.

| # | Pair | Decision and direct basis |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 開く–開ける | **Retain** frozen safeguard; alternate ひらく also permits transitive opening. |
| 2 | 付ける–着る | **Retain** frozen safeguard and explicit wearing-family teaching. |
| 3 | 付ける–掛ける | **Retain** frozen safeguard. Different primary titles do not justify deletion. |
| 4 | 消す–洗う | **Accept:** actual Russian «стирать» independently covers erasing and washing clothes. |
| 5 | 付ける–履く | **Accept:** named modern dictionary explicitly supplies 着ける／はかまをつける. This is not a suffix argument or unrestricted spelling permission. |
| 6 | 付ける–締める | **Accept:** both full sources explicitly teach fastening a seatbelt. |
| 7 | 締める–着る | **Accept:** independent belt/necktie wearing sense meets unqualified «надевать». |
| 8 | 押す–付ける | **Accept:** independent gold-leaf affixing sense—not pressing a light switch or sliding a seal. |
| 9 | 並ぶ–立つ | **Accept:** standing in a line admits «стоять». Objects and seated arrangements remain separate valid uses. |
| 10 | 並ぶ–待つ | **Accept:** ordinary queueing admits generic «ждать». This does not make waiting necessary for every arrangement; no invented 順番を待つ quotation is needed. |
| 11 | 閉まる–立つ | **Accept:** exact-written 立つ sense 17 explicitly covers a shut door/shoji. |
| 12 | 始まる–立つ | **Accept:** exact-written 立つ sense 15 independently covers a season beginning. |
| 13 | 止まる–座る | **Accept:** actual perching example naturally gives Russian «сидеть». |
| 14 | 止まる–休む | **Accept:** 休む independently includes suspending ongoing activity/business—not merely sleeping or leisure. |
| 15 | 止まる–終わる | **Accept**, correcting the caption quotation above. Cessation can admit «заканчиваться»; a temporary pause is not necessarily completed work. |
| 16 | 引く–遊ぶ | **Accept:** instrument-playing sense has **“usu. written as 弾く”**, not a hard restriction excluding 引く; generic «играть» creates the risk. |
| 17 | 開く–咲く | **Accept:** exact alternate ひらく has bloom sense; the complete 咲く article independently supplies 花が開く. |
| 18 | 付ける–入れる | **Accept:** actual sugar-in-coffee teaching supports «добавлять» for 入れる—not merely English synonymy. |
| 19 | 付ける–書く | **Accept:** independent diary/entry sense and actual 日記を書く support «писать». |
| 20 | 並ぶ–同じ | **Accept:** equality in the compared respect is directly supported by the matching/rival sense and 同じ’s full explanation—not physical identity. |
| 21 | 並べる–同じ | **Accept separately:** its own equal/as-good-as sense supports the compared-property reading. Not inherited through 並ぶ or a claim of grammatical interchangeability. |
| 22 | 開ける–晴れる | **Accept:** alternate ひらける becoming clear meets unqualified «проясняться»; primary あける retains its own grammar. |
| 23 | 引く–持つ | **Accept:** Russian «держать ноту» makes the sustained-note sense directly relevant—not English “hold a meeting.” |
| 24 | 付ける–咲く | **Accept independently:** producing flowers admits Russian «цвести» for the plant. Not inherited through 開く, and not based on suffix-only senses. |

## Additional direct-pair questions

- **開く–広い: UNVERIFIED.** The complete alternate-reading object explicitly includes “to be wide (gap, etc.) / to widen,” but I cannot confidently establish whether actual «широкий; просторный» is defensible for the bare quiz word rather than a paraphrase of a widening/resulting gap. Do not silently add or dismiss this edge on the English gloss alone.
- **引く–消える:** no additional guard established. Fading/subsiding does not by itself establish the actual «исчезать; гаснуть» caption.
- **始まる–起きる:** no additional guard established by the supplied occurrence example and senses; beginning and occurrence are not automatically equivalent.
- **締める–掛ける:** no additional guard established. Generic binding is insufficient proof for the actual «затягивать; застёгивать» caption.

I found no other confirmed additional direct pair in the actual combined captions.

## Other conclusions and limits

The full primary bodies preserve the material teaching boundaries: readings, stems, cause-neutral 消える, 止まる alternatives, particle roles, agency versus neatness, and push/pull qualifications. Optional wrapper removal retains substantive teaching; I found no missing mandatory provider in this scope.

The four housekeeping diffs introduce no additional ambiguity requiring correction. They distinguish authorized source authoring from ordinary activation and preserve bounded historical native receipts. I did not independently verify the remote issue bodies.

The pinned mapping lacks `attachment` and falls back to the raw tag **at that app pin only**. Keep the canonical ID; this remains a separate app follow-up.

Final helper verification passed for the exact snapshot, baseline RAWs, pair fingerprints, pool artifact and excluded sky draft. **Nothing was written or changed; no tests/builds/emulators, agents or external AI were used.** The findings and unresolved pair prevent a clean overall acceptance.
